description.value: Websters Corner Store is a family-run convenience store on Dewdney Trunk Road in Maple Ridge, known for its friendly service and a small in-house deli. Reviewers single out house-made egg salad sandwiches and beef samosas as standout items. It sits on a busy road through the Fraser Valley, making it a potential resupply stop for cyclists riding the Dewdney Trunk corridor.

address.value: 25559 Dewdney Trunk Rd, Maple Ridge, BC V4R 1X8, Canada
